create_pegasustokenizer: create a PegasusTokenizer instance with a SentencePiece vocab file for text tokenization
configure_pegasustokenizer_special_token: configure PegasusTokenizer with custom pad, eos, unk, mask tokens and additional special tokens
tokenize_text_pegasus: tokenize text input using PegasusTokenizer with Metaspace pre-tokenization and Unigram model
build_pegasus_tokenizer_pair_processing: build PegasusTokenizer with TemplateProcessing post-processor for single and pair sequence tokenization
normalize_text_pegasus: normalize text with PegasusTokenizer replacing newlines and multiple spaces before tokenization
